text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Activity at the electoral commission reached fever pitch at the weekend, indicating that local elections may be held this month as scheduled on the military government's timetable to restore democracy.
- Confederation of African Football names Kanu Nwankwo, captain of Nigeria's Olympic gold winning soccer team, as African Footballer of the Year. Kanu recently underwent surgery for a heart defect.
- Nigeria has urged the European Union to show more understanding of the country's human rights situation, after the EU last week extended sanctions imposed over human rights abuses.
- Former military ruler General Ibrahim Babangida pulled through complicated surgery for a blood clot in France at the weekend.
- Used Nigerian Telecommunications smart cards are being reprogrammed by fraudsters.
